claims.text: Google shut down the Q&A feature on Google Business Profile listings in late 2025.
Ask Maps now generates an AI answer on the spot instead of relying on public Q&A, pulling from profile details, reviews, photos, and website.
A thin services section, stale photos, and vague review replies give the AI less accurate material to answer customer questions from.
Cheap, urgent leads tend to fill the calendar first because they require the least qualification
Higher-value jobs often need qualifying questions before booking and can get lost to a faster-reacting competitor
The platform includes quiz funnels that qualify a lead before it reaches the calendar

disclosure: The 17% and 2x figures reflect commonly published lead-response-time research, not Black Arrow proprietary data, and are now attributed as such in the copy. The missed-call text-back claim describes an actual Black Arrow platform capability.

claims.text: About 17% of service businesses answer a new lead within an hour, according to published lead-response research.
Answering a lead within five minutes roughly doubles the close rate compared to a slower response, per published lead-response studies.
Black Arrow's platform can automatically text back a missed call to keep the lead engaged before a human callback.
The age of a lead, not the volume of leads, determines how fast it goes cold.
